name: Houston
intro: The MICHELIN Guide Texas has covered Houston since its first edition in 2024. Its starred kitchens range from Indian (Musaafer) and Mexican (Tatemó) to Spanish (BCN) and French (Le Jardinier, at the Museum of Fine Arts). CorkScrew BBQ, in Spring north of the city, is on the Texas page. Prices are in US dollars, per person before tax and tip (or the service charge some restaurants add), checked October 2026.
